source_text: þæslícness, e; f. Fitness, meetness, agreement with what is right :-- Ða hláfordas hé manode ðæt hí milde wǽron heora ðeówum mannum mid þæslícnysse (v. Col. 4, 1 : Domini, quod justum est et aequum, servis praestate), Homl. Th. ii. 326, 27. v. un-þæslícness.
